turns.question: Using the first half of 2025 as the baseline, which 10 sessions from July 1, 2025 through January 30, 2026 were the most unusual among the same 1,000 stocks, and did any of them belong to those six stocks? Name the sessions and the features that made each one unusual. Anomaly scores are neither forecasts nor explanations.

report.markdown:

| 2 | 2025-08-01 | DGNX | 438 | 1‑day return: **+360σ**; 5‑day return: **+153σ**; 20‑day realized vol: **+109σ**; 20‑day volume deviation: **–2.20σ** |

Only **ABVX** (which was the #3 strongest return over the full window) appears in the anomaly list, on **2025-07-23** (rank 3) and **2025-07-29** (rank 9). The other five — DFDV, AXTI, DOGZ, CHOW, DFNS — did not have any sessions in the top-10 anomaly list for this scoring window.

**Note:** Anomaly scores and observed deviations are descriptive reason codes (robust z‑scores against the training window); they are not forecasts, probabilities, or explanations of cause.
